description: This file defines the PageableParamProvider class, which implements Jersey's ValueParamProvider to supply Pageable objects for API methods annotated with @Pagination. It processes query parameters like page, size, and sort to construct and return a PageRequest for pagination and sorting, including default sorting if specified via annotations.

classes.name: PageableParamProvider
classes.description: Implements Jersey's ValueParamProvider to supply Pageable objects for API pagination, supporting annotation-based configuration and query parameter parsing.

classes.name: PageableFunction
classes.description: A record implementing Function<ContainerRequest, Pageable> that constructs a Pageable object based on HTTP request parameters and annotations.

methods.name: getValueProvider
methods.description: Returns a Function that creates a Pageable object if the parameter type is Pageable and annotated with @Pagination.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level (HIGH) indicating this provider's preference.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Builds and returns a Pageable (PageRequest) object using query parameters, annotation defaults, and sorting info.
